name: metal
description: Small files, a deliberate language, a toolchain that refuses. Three rules, all enforced by hooks.

plugins.name: metal
plugins.description: Small files, a deliberate language, a toolchain that refuses. Denies any source file over 300 lines at write time, warns at 220 while there is still room to split well, asks the language question once on a new project, and checks that C++, TypeScript and Python projects actually turn their strict mode on.
